newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil/Neste Borealis petchem plant to shed jobs.
newsitem.headline: Statoil/Neste Borealis petchem plant to shed jobs.

text.p: The Borealis petrochemical complex at Bamble south of the Norwegian capital Oslo will cut its workforce by the equivalent of 150 full-time jobs over the next three to four years, Den norske stats oljeselskap AS said on Thursday.
Borealis is a joint venture between state Norwegian oil company Statoil and Neste Oy of Finland.

Statoil said the reductions would take place through redeployment and natural wastage and were part of a broader strategic process that also would involve investment in the plant to raise output with fewer staff.
Bamble currently employees a workforce of about 500.
"Overall savings, including payroll reductions, will total about 80 million crowns," Stig Blomberg, president, told Statoil's Status Weekly newsletter.
"Combined with the planned spending, this will secure our long-term competitiveness," Blomberg said.
